description_en: Modifies the policy for a scheduled task
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-cron-job-policy-serverless --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cron-expression 0_0_13_0_0_0 --end-time 2020-02-12T15:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCronJobPolicyServerless

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of PolarDB Capacity Units (PCUs). Valid values: 0.25 to 32. This value must be less than or equal to the value of ScaleMax
parameters.help_zh: 最小值:0.25~32 PCU，且最小值 <= 最大值。单位：PCU
parameters.name: scale_min

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of PCUs. Valid values: 1 to 32
parameters.name: scale_max

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 只读节点个数的伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: scale_ro_num_min

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 只读节点个数的伸缩上限0~15个可选, 且不能大于上限的值。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: scale_ro_num_max

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable No-activity Suspension. Valid values:

true: Enables the feature.

false (default): Disables the feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启无活动暂停。取值范围如下：

true：开启

false（默认）：关闭
parameters.name: allow_shut_down

parameters.help_en: The detection period for No-activity Suspension. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 5 to 1440. The value must be a multiple of 5
parameters.help_zh: 无活动暂停的检测时长。取值范围：5~1440。单位分钟。检测时长必须是5分钟的倍数
parameters.name: seconds_until_auto_pause

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 只读列存节点个数下限。取值范围：0～15
parameters.name: scale_ap_ro_num_min

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of read-only column store nodes. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 只读列存节点个数上限。取值范围：0～15
parameters.name: scale_ap_ro_num_max

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-up. Unit: percent. Valid values: 40 to 100
parameters.name: serverless_rule_cpu_enlarge_threshold

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold for a scale-down. Unit: percent. Valid values: 10 to 100. The value of ServerlessRuleCpuEnlargeThreshold minus the value of this parameter must be greater than or equal to 30
parameters.help_zh: cpu弹降阈值。最小值:10~100 %，且最大值 - 最小值 >= 30
parameters.name: serverless_rule_cpu_shrink_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The scaling sensitivity. Valid values:

normal

flexible
parameters.help_zh:
弹性灵敏度。取值：

normal：标准
flexible：灵敏
parameters.name: serverless_rule_mode

parameters.help_en: The start time. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled task
parameters.name: job_id
